candidates.name: git-stash documentation
verified_facts: git stash push records working-tree and index state
--include-untracked includes untracked files and removes them from the working tree
semantic_limits: The recovery keeps refs/stash for manual inspection and never automatically reapplies or drops it

candidates.name: git-status porcelain format
verified_facts: Porcelain v1 is a stable machine-readable status format
semantic_limits: Status detects changes but does not judge their value; snapshot and stash preserve them

candidates.name: git-fetch atomic synchronization
verified_facts: git fetch downloads remote objects and updates remote-tracking refs
semantic_limits: Fetch does not modify the worktree; exact verified reset remains required

candidates.name: Wait-Process Timeout
verified_facts: Wait-Process waits for a process to stop
Timeout bounds the wait and reports expiry
semantic_limits: Timeout remains a fail-closed blocker and is not counted as successful recovery
